distance_prior: Gaussian in D/Dcat centered 1 with sigma eD/D; truncated to [max(0.1,1-3sigma),1+3sigma]
inclination_prior: Gaussian degrees centered catalog i with sigma catalog e_i, truncated to [max(1,i-3e_i),min(90,i+3e_i)]
ML_prior: Gaussian in log10 ML centered log10(0.5/0.7), sigma 0.1 dex; MAP density defined in these log coordinates
prior_justification: Li+2018 use lognormal stellar ML scatter 0.1 dex and catalog geometry errors. Here tails are explicitly bounded engineering/sensitivity policy; not identical posterior inference. No cosmological halo prior.
geometry_frame: Project physical model into catalog deprojected velocity frame: sin(i_new)/sin(i_catalog). Observed velocities and quoted errors unchanged.
profile_type: F0 NFW log10 M200 fixed grid, refit log10 c; truncated grid, no interval endpoints implied
domain_policy: No silent radius exclusions. F0 unsupported model records invalid indices; comparability only on identical successful masks. F1 invalid-domain proposals rejected/recorded; if a feasible prior box cannot be evaluated, fit reports failure.
numerical_tolerance_rationale: Keep Gate0 identity/limit tolerances; synthetic noiseless known-model log parameters must recover within 1e-5 dex; reruns 1e-10. Values frozen before M1 scientific execution.
